visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an eye-level shot of the Taipei 101 skyscraper reaching into a bright blue sky filled with white clouds. A large black title box with yellow text appears in the center. A man with black-framed glasses, wearing a tan t-shirt and light-blue baggy jeans, stands in front of a green Pokémon-themed entrance gate, waving his hand enthusiastically to the camera. (2) The setting shifts to an outdoor festival area at the Taipei 101 Water Dance Plaza. Numerous red lanterns are hung on strings above. The man walks past various colorful Pokémon inflatables, including a small winged character and a massive, six-meter-tall yellow Pikachu inflatable that dominates the background. The lighting is bright natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the paved ground. (3) The man engages in a series of carnival-style games. He is seen shooting a brown basketball into a hoop, throwing balls at a numbered nine-square grid, and tossing orange ping pong balls into plastic cups. He uses expressive hand gestures, pointing at the camera and raising his arms in triumph. His facial expressions are animated, showing wide smiles and excitement. (4) The scene transitions to a game trial area under a white tent. The man holds a black Nintendo Switch controller and watches a large TV screen displaying a Pokémon battle. The screen shows a Mega Lucario character performing a special move with colorful digital effects. The man gestures toward the screen with his hands, looking surprised and impressed. (5) In the final phase, the man stands once again in front of the giant Pikachu inflatable, now wearing a yellow Pikachu-themed headband. He stands with his hands on his hips and then points directly at the camera. Text overlays at the bottom provide event dates and location details against the sunny urban backdrop.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 巨大皮卡丘出現在台北!. (2) [Subtitle]: 我現在人在101水舞廣場. [Slogan]: 參加《寶可夢傳說 Z-A》夜市祭. (3) [Subtitle]: 一來到夜市祭現場就可以看到高達六公尺的巨型皮卡丘. (4) [Slogan]: 投籃球規則：30秒內投五球，投進兩球及過關. [Slogan]: 一局有30秒 挑戰時間 成功投進任意2球即可完成任務並獲得集章!. (5) [Slogan]: 九宮格規則：總共投五球，打中兩球及過關. (6) [Variety]: 成功. (7) [Slogan]: 乒乓球規則：總共丟十顆球，丟進一顆球及過關. [Slogan]: 乒乓球 歡迎挑戰 一局10顆. (8) [Slogan]: 套圈圈規則：丟五次圈圈，套進兩個瓶子及過關. [Slogan]: 套圈圈 中2個即過關. (9) [Slogan]: 推杯子規則：推三次杯子，推進綠色框內一次及過關. (10) [Slogan]: 闖關注意事項. (11) [Slogan]: 只要集滿三個印章就可以兌換《寶可夢傳說 Z-A》登場寶可夢貼紙一張 共十款. (12) [Slogan]: 遊戲試玩區體驗《寶可夢傳說 Z-A》Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. (13) [Slogan]: 超級路卡利歐!!! 子彈拳!. (14) [Subtitle]: 這次《寶可夢傳說 Z-A》他跟以往寶可夢的對戰是回合制很不一樣. (15) [Slogan]: 最重要的夜市祭還有快閃店. (16) [Slogan]: 台灣人氣插畫家亞拉特別繪製的快龍貼紙乙張. (17) [Slogan]: 《寶可夢傳說 Z-A》夜市祭 2025.10.16 (四)~19日 (日) 台北信義區 台北101水舞廣場 等你來!!!.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-pitched, energetic male greeting. A rapid cinematic 'whoosh' transition sound effects cuts into a bright, high-tempo Pokémon-themed orchestral track with prominent synthesizers and electronic drums. The speaker's voice is loud and projected with high arousal. (2) As the man plays games, a series of distinct sound effects are heard: the hollow 'thud' of a basketball hitting the rim followed by a metallic 'ding' bell for success. The sound of rapid-fire ping pong ball bounces against plastic creates a percussive texture. The speaker shouts 'Success!' with a rising intonation. (3) During the game trial section, digital UI sound effects like pings and combat slashes from the game are mixed into the track. The background music remains continuous but allows the speaker's vocal clarity to remain high. Small incidental noises like the clicking of a stamp and the rustling of paper are briefly audible. (4) The final phase features a crescendo in the background music. The speaker delivers a fast-paced call to action with a very high speech rate. A final triumphant jingle and a synthesized impact sound effect conclude the audio track.
